notes: הַיּוֹם carries no preposition, so the supplied *on* of *on the day* belongs to the noun whose case-function licenses it (rule 33), and the article takes the written *the*.
The frame's *that* goes to the apodosis waw s014 rather than to the presentative הָיָה (rule 45); the competing reading is named in that unit.
בְּתוֹךְ → *among* fuses under rule 30's one-English-word condition; giving *among* to בְּ alone would leave a lexical noun's rendering unaligned against rule 2.
גַּם is present in the clause, so the *also* is its own and rule 51's waw case is not in play.
